sentences.text: Marinepro diving services oy is a company registered on 2026-08-13 under the industry code 42990, construction of other civil engineering projects.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-08-18.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a marine word but the registered industry is civil engineering construction and the record shows no technology.
